name: zinc-scenes/v2
purpose: P1 Site scenes, look v2 (X3D 4.1): one world per deposited zinc finger structure (model 1). Accepting under it means each scene is valid X3D 4.1 at the family validator pin, carries no known trap, and draws only what the deposited coordinates say: every v0 check (atoms, selection, bonds, glow under 2.5 angstrom, measured-length labels, tube anchors), plus: every atom drawn with its own element's material (zinc as zinc) and the element colours pairwise distinct, a coordination cage exactly where four ligands all glow with its vertices on those donors, and each label naming its donor as deposited. The look (physically based materials, the generated studio environment, lights, tone mapping) is declared, not checked; reading it is the eyes record, graded S.
limitations: Model 1 of each deposited file only; the per-model spread is in the P1 census, not in the scenes.

The data-true reader shares the donor table, the side-chain atom lists, the 2.5 angstrom glow line and the spline sampling with the builder; it is independent in parsing (MDAnalysis), selection and arithmetic.
The glow line is a display rule, not the metal-site window: a bond can glow and still fail the witness (for example a Zn-S of 2.461 A).
The studio environment is a generated 32-pixel cube map so software GL can render it; it is look, not data, and it reflects no real room.
The cage and colour checks bind the drawn names and coordinates, not the pixels: a renderer that ignores PhysicalMaterial would still pass.
The scenes have no ROUTEs or scripts, so there is no behaviour to judge; the camera is the only thing that moves.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
